positions.title: Platform, Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led extensive modernization efforts of our outdated dependency stack, implementing structured methods for upgrading, testing, and validating updates, ensuring no adverse impact on any of the 1000+ modules in our codebase.

Successfully migrated a large-scale, multi-module project from using data binding, achieving a 35-50% reduction in incremental build times.

Spearheaded the migration to Jetpack Compose by creating multiple real-world use cases, developing a UI Component showcase app, documenting testing methods, and formulating comprehensive educational plans for over 60 Android Engineers at Capital One.

positions.title: Tech Lead, Android
positions.description:
Led a team of four engineers to successfully develop a feature that competed with a leading bill-tracking app.

Conducted weekly one-on-one meetings with team members, offering mentorship and career guidance.

Orchestrated planning sessions for work items and tasks, ensuring a three-month lead time.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led all Android and mobile planning sessions, shaping the future direction of Chowbus mobile apps.

- Organized sprint planning, grooming, and processes for the Android team, while mentoring and pairing with junior engineers.

- Spearheaded the adoption of the MVVM architecture pattern, implemented CI workflows via Bitrise, integrated Test-Driven Development principles, and migrated 40% of the codebase to Kotlin within 4 months.
- Collaborated effectively with teams in China to ensure seamless workflow and maintain high code quality.

positions.title: Senior Android Engineer
positions.description:
- Managed, maintained, and released multiple different apps for various clients
- Built a white-label, multi-module Android app from the ground up using some of the industries best practices, including Jetpack Compose
- Coordinated with multiple small-scale teams every week in order to meet very strict client deadlines for new and exciting features of their applications

positions.title: Android Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed considerably to the ongoing progress of refactoring legacy app screens in order to implement a new design language adopted by the organization, as well as revamp our screen navigation controller and migrate to a new architecture pattern.
- Collaborated with quality engineers on testing sprint work of other team members to ensure acceptance criteria is fully met and functionally consistent in all environments within the biweekly sprint time frame.
- Upheld Test Driven Development principles with every viable pull request, as well as furthering those principles by constantly adding small improvements to our CI workflows.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Revamped the company’s android application to use popular libraries that match best practices
- Learned Ruby on Rails to contribute to the development of the internal management portal and reach a better understanding of our mobile APIs

positions.title: Retail Sales Representative
positions.description:
Designed new methods of marketing pushes that have increased sales by 50 percent.
Cooperated with team members to achieve daily sales goals and initiatives.
Researched advancements in the industry to better fit consumers with the right device.

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
Collaborated with student programmers and designers in developing an educational portal for veterans.
Researched various frameworks and Libraries to make the final product seamless.
Worked alongside Resolute Consulting LLC to implement brand design requests.

positions.title: Advanced Repair Technician
positions.description:
Diagnosed and repaired problems concerning computer hardware, software, and networks.
Developed techniques for class professors to enhance teaching practices through Open Education Resources.
Structured workflow that balances projects based on scale and priority.

positions.title: Marketing Representative
positions.description:
Initiated in-store displays to increase sales by 110% in digital imaging.
Arranged and improving methods to push products out to a wider audience.
Delivered daily reports on sales progress, as well as correlated with higher management .

projects.title: Stock Hawk
projects.description:
Application for tracking stocks over the course of its history using the Yahoo Finance API.
Implements data caching and data usage limitations to lower battery strain.
Upholds the material design guidelines with beautiful animations and colors.

projects.title: Movie Fetcher
projects.description:
Multi-page responsive application that fetches film data from the OpenMovieDB JSON Database.
Implements full data optimization to store data via Content providers and reduce constant data fetching.
Master-Detail navigation for larger screen devices.
